text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the last day of summer camp.
Vodka is
staring out at the ocean by
herself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, hey. Is it already time for the
bus to
leave?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nothin'. I was just reflectin' on our time
at camp. I
got in a lot better training
than I expected to.
choice_data_list: もう少しあるけど、どうした？
もう少しあるけど、どうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: There's still a bit left. What's up?
There's still a bit left. What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
On the beach, in the mountains, even on
uneven
ground... I really improved my
sprinting a bunch.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I usually don't have the patience Scarlet
does, so
I didn't expect to get this far.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But for some reason, I never got tired of
training.
Something kept pushing me on.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The sense that I'm... Y'know what, you
might be
right.
choice_data_list: カッコよさ磨きだったから？
choice_data_list_en: Was it to work on your coolness?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The whole time, I was thinking that I'd
be cooler if
I could just improve my
acceleration.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah, but it turns out that's no big deal.
Doin' your
best isn't about forcin'
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's finding something you wanna try for.
I think
doin' that might be enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We stand side by side and look up at
the evening
summer sky together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I found it now, too, Scarlet. Something
to be
proud of.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to take on number one...
You.
